SELECT uid AS userId,user_name,real_name,mobile FROM sys_user_info WHERE delete_state=1
AND user_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR real_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT sui.uid AS userId,sui.user_name,sui.real_name,sui.mobile, COALESCE((SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_user sru where sru.user_id=sui.uid AND sru.role_id=#{roleId} limit 1),0) AS flagState FROM sys_user_info sui WHERE sui.delete_state=1
AND sui.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR sui.real_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT sui.uid AS userId,sui.user_name,sui.real_name,sui.mobile, COALESCE((SELECT 1 FROM sys_post_user spu where spu.user_id=sui.uid AND spu.post_id=#{postId} limit 1),0) AS flagState FROM sys_user_info sui WHERE sui.delete_state=1
AND sui.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR sui.real_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT sui.uid AS userId,sui.user_name,sui.real_name,sui.mobile, COALESCE((SELECT 1 FROM sys_department_user sdu where sdu.user_id=sui.uid AND sdu.department_id=#{departmentId} limit 1),0) AS flagState FROM sys_user_info sui WHERE sui.delete_state=1
AND sui.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR sui.real_name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_info SET last_login_ip=#{params.ip}, last_login_time=#{params.date}, login_count=(COALESCE(login_count,0)+1) WHERE uid=#{params.uid}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(COALESCE ( sm.data_scope, 0 )) AS dataScope,m.menu_code AS permissionsCode FROM sys_role_menu sm INNER JOIN sys_role_user sr ON sr.role_id = sm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON sm.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE sr.user_id=#{userId} AND m.menu_code!='' GROUP BY m.menu_code

SELECT du.user_id FROM sys_department_user du WHERE 1 = 1
AND du.department_id IN
#{dept}
GROUP BY du.user_id
SELECT du.department_id FROM sys_department_user du WHERE du.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY du.department_id

SELECT sui.uid, sui.user_name, sd."id" AS deptId, sd."name" AS deptName FROM sys_user_info sui LEFT JOIN sys_department_user sdu ON sdu.user_id = sui.uid LEFT JOIN sys_department sd ON sd."id" = sdu.department_id
